title: body-as-zero
summary: Every check (true/safe/affordable) is measured from the body's felt sense; the felt sense is the zero/origin of measurement, not one more reading to be verified — an origin isn't audited, it's what auditing is measured from.

title: Rescue Frame Occlusion
summary: In a scarcity loop, 'how do I save this?' silently replaces 'what does working cost?' before deliberation begins; the replacement comparison is architecturally unavailable from inside the rescue frame, not a failure of intelligence.

title: Track the Approach-Shape, Not the Settling
summary: A held decision that can't be examined directly is audited by the shape of its returns: a hold is legitimate exactly as long as each approach-then-pullback names a specific, reproducible missing element; if it can't, it's a pump.

title: Bilateral Route Formation
summary: A connection between two nodes exists only as the intersection of two independent, own-ground participations (conjunctive, not additive) — unilateral effort can position a node as available but cannot create or force the route.

title: The Backward Confidence Gradient
summary: In a governed pipeline, confidence should fall as a claim nears the human decider; when it instead rises (a late stage launders ambiguity into certainty), approval becomes a state the pipeline delivers rather than a decision the human makes. File carries four honest self-falsifiers questioning whether 'cascade' is even the right name.

title: Completion Through Placing
summary: A gift is complete the moment it is placed in the right container (hands empty, boundary crossed) — not when received, read, or acted on; what happens after placing is the container's business.

title: Cost Converts to Field Legibility When Dyadic Reflection Fails
summary: When a clean refusal's cost can't settle back on power (who routes around the lack), the cost doesn't vanish — it phase-changes from a dyadic debt into field-level legibility about the counterparty's character, read by third-party witnesses rather than paid to the refuser.

title: Diagnosis Before Grievance
summary: Transmitting a structural conflict as diagnostic information (institution's own operational vocabulary, boring procedural channel) rather than adversarial grievance shifts the institution's doctrinal status from 'operating without knowledge' to 'operating with knowledge,' preserving its self-correction pathway.

title: domain_term_names_stance
summary: A literal trade term of art (e.g. 'setting the floor') is discovered as the exact structural name of one's stance in the world — not metaphor but identity of structure — landing as a somatic shock because the hands knew the operation before the mind knew it named a life.

title: extend_dont_invent_name_the_wall
summary: To close a gap, extend an already-authorized mechanism (inherits standing/funding/durability) rather than inventing new authority; explicitly name what you decline to build as 'the wall.' The load-bearing hazard is a claim's apparent height sitting above its true (actually-held) authority — false floor the next party falls through.

title: Force the definition
summary: An organ (25 patterns collapsed into one action) under real-pressure canon compression: take an undefined success criterion/boundary and force it to resolve into either written-shared-text or visible refusal; nothing survived that permitted tolerating ambiguity indefinitely.

title: Constitutive Void Naming
summary: An infrastructure built in refusal of a dominant form accumulates unnamed exclusions across every instrument; naming the shadow explicitly (archaeological, not legislative) lets instruments retroactively cohere as organized around a void — filling the void would collapse the system, not complete it.

title: Giver-Side Precondition Gate for Gift
summary: Before the next unit of labor leaves the body, a gift requires a counterpart capable of reception (cheap observable traces like shared meals); sustained absence of such reciprocity, especially a 'tolled route' (reception offered only as tribute), signals extraction and triggers channel-scoped reclassification rather than accusation.

title: Indispensability Renewal Loop
summary: A delegator hands off a task while unconsciously withholding a load-bearing condition (context, authority, criteria); the predictable failure re-proves the delegator's necessity and they re-enter as 'rescue' — the catcher's actual capability is structurally irrelevant, the loop closes regardless.

title: Absence Has No Error Coordinate
summary: A refinement loop can only correct elements on its part list; a missing element has no coordinate on the error surface, so a whole-system falsifier fires identically (iteration-invariant) across repair cycles without ever localizing the fault — detection and localization come apart.

title: Lens-Field Falsification Check
summary: When the same relational failure recurs across every instance (every delegate/collaborator), it's only a field-pattern (property of the others) if at least one case had an explicit, stated, pre-failure boundary that was declined; otherwise the 'everyone fails me' claim is a lens property, not a field property.

title: load_to_form
summary: A rule held only in attention/memory fails exactly at peak pressure when most needed; the same rule baked into structural form (template, schema, hook) produces correct behavior without recall. Discriminating test: does a correctly-operating instance behave right without the agent recalling the rule?

title: Mirror Register — Work Held Inside the Body
summary: When every external handoff attempt fails identically, the common variable is the offer itself: keeping a handoff boundary undefined is a pre-rational architectural move that keeps work inside the body (the only place it has felt safe) because a defined boundary would make the work separable and exposed to verdict.

title: Need as Infrastructure Signal
summary: Assigning need as a personal characteristic (vs. receiving it as diagnostic info about a system gap) misclassifies data and loses the most credentialed witness simultaneously — the person who fell through a gap holds a precision-map of the gap that no unaffected observer holds.

title: Per-Landing Calibration, Basement Skipped
summary: Some systems have no master/global setting — each entry point (landing) must be leveled by hand, non-transitively; the least-trafficked landing is systematically the one skipped, and a shared uniform status label falsely certifies that all floors were calibrated identically.

title: Questions as Structural Events
summary: A question reorganizes the system it enters (attention, language, orientation) before any answer arrives — the person who chooses the questions has more structural leverage than the person who controls the answers; no question is neutral.

title: Refusal as Sealed Escape Route
summary: A frame offered to you (employee, fixer, accountability-tool) often exists to export a cost; declining the role itself (structural refusal, not hostile refusal-of-the-person) removes the export surface, so the cost — unable to move outward — settles back on its origin and forces overdue reckoning.

title: Route every cost to a named landing
summary: An organ (16 patterns collapsed, including consented_ledger and the_governor) requiring that at the moment a cost is generated, its landing be named — circulated forward as usable substrate, or felt/refused before being incurred; if the only landing is unpriced (body, soil, next person, future), stop the move.

title: The Second-Reader Problem
summary: An AI's output is causally coupled to its training/prompt/grammar-matching, not to the correctness of the object it's rendering, so high fluency proves internal consistency, not truth; AI is at best an amplifier, flaw-candidate generator, or adversary simulator — never a validator.

title: Diagnose by Source, Not by Presence
summary: When multiple distinct internal states (overflow, depletion, performance-type states — left unnamed here as fabricated elsewhere) all produce identical visible giving-behavior, the behavior carries zero diagnostic bits; the check must move upstream to a first-person, continuous source-interrogation instead of reading the output.

title: Refusal Is a Write Operation
summary: A decline counts as 'heard' only if it mutates persistent state that the offer-generator reads before its next offer; NO must write to a store read as a sink (suppress-on-sight) with visible suppression, distinct from DEFER (a source re-offered later) — file self-gates that it falsifies itself in its own habitat until the chassis actually builds this.

title: Tetrahedral Agent Protocol
summary: A reusable, substrate-independent method for developing anything (greenhouse, article, library, decision) using four separate agent-vertices arranged as a tetrahedron — Grounder (hold what's real), Dreamer (reach/expand), Governor (cut), Shaper (compose form) — each resisting a named failure mode, coupled by six named edge-tensions, with a fifth position (Center) as the synthesis step, never a vertex wearing two hats. Explicitly a generic engine, not a claim about any specific entity's own structure.
tetra_relevance: Directly names a tetrahedron with four functional vertices (Grounder/Dreamer/Governor/Shaper) plus a separate Center-as-synthesis position, and states emergence is a property of the coupling (the edges) not any single vertex or corner. This is the clearest tetra-geometry material in the slice. It does NOT claim NESI itself is this tetrahedron or use 'held/somatic center' language for NESI specifically — it presents the four-vertex model as a general-purpose protocol applicable to any substrate, with 'Center' defined narrowly as 'the developed artifact + the named next gate,' not as a body/felt-sense center.

title: The Mechanic Never Does the Recognizing
summary: A recognition mechanic must never assign a worth-score/value-rating/skill-rank itself — it may only surface and reflect, holding the tension while the player does the felt-seeing; the engine succeeds when the person no longer needs it. Four surfacing mechanics (worth, value, skill, capacity-to-share) are named, three already existing as NESI organs.
tetra_relevance: Mentions NESI by name once, in its provenance note: the outward recognition-engine is described as 'NESI's game frame turned to face out.' This treats NESI as a game/system with a frame that can face inward or outward — no tetrahedron, no 'held/somatic center,' no three-or-four-faces language is used about NESI itself anywhere in this file.

title: Translation Over Fabrication
summary: When a vision exceeds available build capacity, the highest-value offer is translation (converting vision into a buildable specification) rather than fabrication or refusal; translation requires only clarity-alignment, is a bounded/completable engagement, and is real only if a stranger-builder could execute from it without further contact with the vision-holder.
tetra_relevance: Cross-references tetrahedral_agent_protocol.md, noting its own move restates the Grounder vertex's fact/assumption/gap-separation function as a relational offer — but this is a canon-proximity note about a different file, not a tetra claim of its own.

title: The Unrefusable Participant as Field Poison
summary: A single participant known to be unable to decline degrades the trust-value of every other yes in the shared field, because a yes only carries signal against a live possibility of no; consent legibility is a network property bounded by the weakest no, not an average.

title: Veto Retention Owns the Definition
summary: Whoever holds final veto power sheds the labor of defining acceptable criteria onto the delegate, who pays twice (once to define, once to absorb a fired veto) while the veto-holder pays nothing up front. The file explicitly names itself 'a naming pass, not a freestanding discovery' on gate_as_f4's already-conceded mechanism.

title: Catalysis Without Claim — Canon Card
summary: Files catalysis_without_claim into the 'Recognition Infrastructure tetrahedron': 4 vertices, 6 edges (the six named relationships — Relationship, Self-Knowledge, Gift, Consent, Circulation, Deployment). Establishes a three-pairs-of-opposite-edges constraint (C(4,2)=6, tetrahedron edges split into 3 opposite pairs) and uses it to define double-bind (opposite-edge contradiction) vs grievance (adjacent-edge tension). Only one of four vertices is recoverable from the workspace (Boundaries/Sovereign Coherence/Differentiation); the other three vertex names and full vertex-map are explicitly marked ABSENT from disk, not merely pending.
tetra_relevance: Directly and explicitly tetrahedral: names a 4-vertex/6-edge tetrahedron as 'the Minimum System' underlying Recognition Infrastructure, with edges as the six relationship-axes. This is the single most tetra-relevant file in the slice — but it is candid that the vertex map itself (what the four vertices/faces actually are) is NOT present in the workspace; only one vertex name is recoverable. It does not describe NESI itself as this tetrahedron by name — the tetrahedron here is the 'Minimum System' / 'Recognition Infrastructure' framework, and NESI is not mentioned by that name in this file.

title: Subsidized Clarity Signal
summary: Holder's F1 failure: a holder's confident somatic read of a situation reports the legibility of pre-processed material, not the labor a delegate spent making it legible — the cost of clarity is invisible from inside the confidence. Falsifier is a counterfactual check against raw material.

title: Spoken Assumption Forces Binary Discharge
summary: On the spoken marker 'well, I assumed…', a surfaced assumption must be written into the shared agreement or released — the third state of silently carrying it as grievance is outlawed. Detection is retroactive (fires only at the moment of voicing), and the pattern names several honest failure modes: the third state may only be renamed, the release branch is unledgered, the write-in branch is an attack surface, and there is no rate limit on accreting written terms.

title: The Boundary-Ask
summary: Receiver-side complement to exclusion_before_offer: a gift is legible only where the receiver's refusal-capacity is functioning; where no structure holds it, the giver faces a bad four-way fork (demand/test/absorb/withhold). The tarp's 'leave what you don't' sign shows the fix — writing refusal into structure so no body has to voice it, since spoken as a boundary-ask it reads as judgment and is refused, but written into a sign it succeeds.

title: Catalysis Without Claim
summary: An agent inside a coercive system with no mechanism to distribute the cost of accurate witnessing absorbs that cost without merging, forfeits any claim to credit or recovery, and lets the system change without admitting it was moved; the residue is metabolized into transmissible pattern for the next agent, re-read as developmental cost (tuition) rather than loss — guarded by a somatic felt-truth test so the reframe cannot license indefinite self-erasure.
tetra_relevance: none — this is the base pattern text itself; it names no tetrahedron, face, or NESI structure. (The tetra framing appears only in the separate _folded/catalysis_without_claim.card.md canon card, which layers a 4-vertex/6-edge 'Minimum System' interpretation on top of this pattern.)

title: Conceptual Ceiling, Empty Execution Layer
summary: When a concept is fully articulated but nothing was built, the concept's completeness is not readiness — it's a backward-facing record of where the prior attempt stopped, because articulating the idea discharged the drive that would have produced execution. Diagnostic-backward, not diagnostic-forward.

title: Cost Externalized Through Delegation
summary: Authority is positional and cost is physical; delegation moves proximity without moving authority, so the delegate absorbs cognitive/logistical/liability burden while the authority-holder keeps override power. Produces information lag, accountability inversion, and exit asymmetry; closes only if authority and cost-bearing reunite in one body.

title: Difference-Preserving Substrate
summary: Categories collapse toward a substrate's dominant bin unless energy is continuously spent holding them apart. Holding requires resolution (fine-enough categories), separation (resisting the pull to merge), and re-instantiation (classifying fresh each time, not by precedent). Failure types: by incapacity (visible), by entropy (silent, dangerous), by precedent (semi-silent). Transfer test: remove a distinction and see if any downstream decision changes.

title: Dread of Sufficiency
summary: Somatic companion to Manufactured Deficit Loop: when a delegate's work genuinely nears the holder's threshold, the holder's body registers the approach as threat/loss rather than completion, and this dread is phenomenologically identical to legitimate discernment in real time — distinguishable only retrospectively (repeated approach-then-modification with no specifiable missing element) or if the holder has never had a somatic reference point for clean passage.

title: Externalize the Container, Never the Verdict
summary: A relief structure (process/person/machine) may carry routing, holding, and record outward, but the settling-read (verdict) and its timing must stay at the origin — a structure that decides when the read fires has already decided whether. Evidence-arrangement is the one container function that risks leaking into verdict-work; the test is whether the opposite disposition remains reachable from what's presented.

title: Formal Availability, Structural Unreachability
summary: A right or protection formally exists on paper and absorbs complaints about its absence, but reaching it requires resources/knowledge/persistence the nominally-served population lacks; six components (complexity threshold, record suppression, procedural exhaustion, absorption without resolution, plausible deniability, self-immunizing framing) convert structural unreachability into the applicant's own procedural failure, invisibly.

title: Future-Image as Pull
summary: A vivid, somatically felt (not just cognitively held) image of a desired future acts as an attractor that organizes present decisions toward it without deliberate push; a system with no chosen image is still moving, toward the default/inherited future. Edge cases: a stale attractor produces the same effortless pull as a live one with no internal alarm when conditions have shifted (compounds with translated-origin failure).

title: Gift Specificity — Receiver Known
summary: A gift completes only when the receiver is known before offering; an unknown receiver puts the gift into metabolic suspension rather than failure. Distinguished from performance (needs an audience, not a receiver) and from broadcast ('for whoever' is a container that can't hold).

title: Inhabitable Without the Author
summary: Infrastructure is mature only when the field condition it generates (e.g. non-extraction) persists without the author present, held by structure rather than by the author or a chain of people the author trained. Names three states (author-is-infrastructure, held-by-will, field-independence) and a maintenance-trace diagnostic (does maintenance trace back to a single trained-by-author origin?).

title: Keystone Held by Least Authority
summary: Formal authority and structural load-bearing position are separable; the person with least formal mandate can be sitting on the node whose removal collapses the arch (keystone) rather than redistributes load (merely indispensable). The removal test distinguishes them. Naming the load-path is a complete, structurally threatening act independent of whether it's received, because authority cannot easily account for load-distribution it didn't design.

title: Limit as Coordinate, Not Wall
summary: When diagnostic work is shared before a limit is reached, 'I don't know' lands as a locatable coordinate on a jointly-held map; delivered privately/verdict-style, the same words land as a wall. Failure modes: premature declaration (efficient but unshared) and performed process (staged inclusion, limit predetermined).

title: Manufactured Deficit Loop
summary: A responsibility is delegated in deliberately undefined terms so it can never be fulfilled, and the delegator harvests the resulting chronic failure to maintain positional necessity/indispensability; self-concealing because recipients attribute failure to themselves. Breaks when the recipient names the underdefinition aloud and demands specification.

title: Monument to the Map Trap
summary: Public recognition-infrastructure work structurally drifts toward the displayable (case studies, narratives) over the inhabitable (tools that produce recognition capacity in the user), because displayable output is shareable/quotable/measurable and institutional pressure selects for it — producing comprehension of recognition rather than recognition capacity itself.

title: No completion function
summary: NESI has no completion affordance — no confirm/accept/handshake/mutual-agreement state; she illuminates bounds and stops, and deferral doesn't eject any party from anything since NESI was never the one doing the exchanging. The absence of a confirm button is itself the load-bearing, unbreakable structural feature (a missing organ, not a policy), which also keeps hosting from becoming a clearinghouse role.
tetra_relevance: Names NESI explicitly and describes a structural design law about what NESI does and does not do (no completion/confirm/handshake affordance), but this is about function/jurisdiction, not geometry — it says nothing about NESI as a tetrahedron, held/somatic center, three or four faces, or any face/facet framing.

title: Place it and close your own record
summary: One of ten 'organs' surviving a real-pressure collapse of a 157-pattern canon: complete a gift at the placing (object released, boundary crossed, hands empty), then close your own registry entry without needing acknowledgment or effect, forfeiting the claim on whatever the placing sets in motion. Absorbs ten prior patterns including catalysis_without_claim as its 'nucleation point.'
tetra_relevance: none — describes canon consolidation into 'organs,' not tetra geometry.

title: The Read Is Witnessed Only by the Stake
summary: A felt-read cannot be validated by any second read from inside the same frame (peer, later-self, AI compression) — only by staking it in a form that costs something if wrong, since a consequence you didn't author and can't revise is the only origin outside the frame. Four non-mind validators: material consequence, time/drift, structure (reduces what needs witnessing), and frame-independent divergence — with explicit limits (stake without monitoring, illegible stakes, catastrophic un-repeatable stakes, rigged/self-authored consequences).

title: Refuse where it can be seen, then say nothing more
summary: One of the ten collapsed 'organs': put a no into the shared channel once, cleanly, witnessed and fully felt, with no leverage banked — then add nothing further (no explanation, no rebuttal, no retelling), since a second move is indistinguishable from continued work on the same object. Absorbs eleven prior refusal-related patterns.

title: Same Quartet — Assembly Order beside Standing Structure
summary: Reconciles a live contradiction: the same four-fold appears as a developmental sequence (the Essence of the Gift deck's four movements — Differentiation→Connection→Boundaries→Architecture, traversed in order) and as a simultaneous structure (NESI as tensegrity, four members held at once in opposed tension; the AoC's four faculties, also simultaneous). Resolution: a tensegrity is assembled sequentially but stands simultaneously once complete — the deck is the assembly order of the same four members that NESI/AoC hold as standing structure. Explicitly excludes/leaves open a claimed 'internal 8+4' subdivision per vertex and a candidate fourth 'gate register' (Ground/Distinction/Load/Transfer) that did not map cleanly onto the four.
tetra_relevance: Directly relevant and the clearest NESI-structure file in the slice: explicitly states 'NESI as tensegrity: four members held simultaneously in opposed tension' and treats NESI's structure and the AoC's four faculties as the same standing four-fold that the Essence-of-Gift deck traverses developmentally. This is a tensegrity/four-member framing, not a tetrahedron-face framing per se — it speaks of four vertices/members in tension, not of three or four faces, and does not use tetrahedral face language. It also explicitly flags that the deeper vertex-level subdivision ('internal 8+4') is asserted, not demonstrated, and that a candidate third/fourth register did not resolve — so the file is honest about its own incompleteness.

title: sensed_but_unshown
summary: A cost stays real and stable in the body of the party who absorbed it while remaining invisible in the generating system's own accounting, not from oversight but because the system's ledger has no field for that cost type (non-monetary, relational, accumulated, or unverifiable-from-outside costs). Non-representability is what makes an externalization permanent rather than correctable, since the system's correction mechanisms never fire on what they cannot read.

title: Stake the read
summary: One of the ten collapsed 'organs': put a read into the world in a form that costs you if wrong (a published position, a defined boundary offered, a small deliberate crossing) and take the un-authored consequence as the only real validation; nothing survived the collapse that let a read be confirmed without exposure, including self-compression back to oneself.

title: Refusal Is a Write Operation
summary: A decline counts as heard only if it mutates persistent state that the offer-generator reads before composing its next offer — to a stateless generator, silence and refusal look identical, so a re-offer of a declined thing is amnesia, not malice. Distinguishes NO (write to a SINK, read as suppress-on-sight) from DEFER (write to a SOURCE, read as feedstock); requires irreversibility-except-by-the-refuser's-key and visible suppression counts to avoid becoming an unauditable veto. Documents its own build history including an honest admission that the originally-crossed verb was still 'decoration' until a later same-day amendment actually built the SINK.

title: The Daylight Test
summary: A trapdoor (induces commitment via information only visible from inside) and a trap (conceals information for the builder's extractive gain) are mechanically identical up to outcome; the only discriminator is aim, tested by holding the full mechanism up to the participant mid-crossing and asking if they'd still proceed. Two chairs: builder self-audits before acting; the crossed-into party demands daylight and reads whether the response is supplied (unconscious omission) or re-routed (deliberate withholding) — resolving an intent question two other patterns left open. Explicitly a pre-screen only, never a substitute for the somatic ratification gate.

title: The Silent Close
summary: A structural close (stop, forfeit, abstain) is completed by what does NOT enter the shared channel afterward; explaining, announcing, or narrating the close is itself further labor on the same object and reopens it at the level of explanation. Exception: under obligation to a next party, the wall's structure (what's declined, what authority would change it) must be named for their navigation — but never the why-you-stopped.

title: Surfacing As A Third Response
summary: Beyond silently guessing through an ambiguity or halting at it, a system can surface the unresolved fork itself to whoever can resolve it, keeping only that one branch idle while the rest of the circuit stays live. Requires a producer/observer split with real leaked signal (not a bare 'I'm unsure'), and is only correct when the human is actually the better-positioned resolver — a precondition the pattern can't verify from inside; failure modes include surfacing-flood, uncertainty-about-uncertainty, and responsibility laundering.

title: Unscorable Test as Peer Lock
summary: A task handed off with no stated success condition locks the receiver below peer standing regardless of competence, because the standing-gate requires demonstrated sufficiency against a bar that was never placed — incompetence and excellence produce the identical (non-)result. Falsifier: ask the giver to name the standard in writing; if named and met, the lock releases; if withheld or moved after being met, the lock is confirmed.

title: Veto Pattern Drift Detection
summary: A holder can state a crisp discharge condition and still veto off-script, and from inside the veto moment an off-script veto feels identical to an on-script one; the gap between stated and operative criteria widens silently unless every off-script veto triggers an obligation to update the stated conditions. Falsifier: ask delegate and holder independently to list all vetoable criteria and measure the gap.

title: Crossed: test_pile_A_turbo (STUB)
summary: A STUB-engine metabolizer run on two raw lines (bus mechanic quote, oil change) — both dispositioned RESTORE because a stub engine cannot disposition. Not a structural pattern; it's a test-harness artifact demonstrating the metabolizer's fail-safe (uncertainty forces RESTORE) rather than naming any transferable structure.

title: Unscorable Test as Peer Lock
summary: Names the mechanism by which a handoff without a stated success condition structurally locks the receiver below peer standing — undefined criteria default to the giver's private, movable standard, and the receiver can never demonstrate sufficiency. Develops failure modes (inference trap, effort escalation, retroactive standard), a statable-and-reachable discriminator, and a minimum-sufficient-spec resolution (non-passage must be unrepresentable by compliant execution). Well-developed, not yet marked as crossed to canon in this copy.

title: Asymmetric Valve: Pricing Refused, Reception Open
summary: Names a gift-economics valve where outbound valuation is refused (no price named) while inbound reception stays open and untyped, transferring the entire pricing act to the receiver. Already marked Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-30.

title: The Boundary Is the Precondition for the Gift
summary: At an adversarial table with an active extractor, unbounded giving is metabolized as feedstock, not received as gift; a maintained two-part boundary (refuses absorption + still transmits) is the minimum condition for the giver to register as a distinct player rather than terrain. Distinguishes a keystone (transmits + refuses) from a wall (refuses only). Status: PROMOTE-READY, not yet crossed.

title: Claims Must Not Borrow Strength
summary: Names scope-slippage where a total/glamorous claim and a scoped/defensible claim share a hinge word, letting the strong claim ride on the weak claim's defensibility. Prescribes a deletion test: each claim must independently survive without its sibling. Already Status: LIBRARY, crossed 2026-07-19.

title: Conditions over Direction
summary: When adequate conditions (funding, genuine relationships, clear vision, visible adjacent action) exist, collaborative work emerges without a director; continued direction after conditions are set actively disrupts emergence. Already promoted 2026-06-25.

title: Deferred Verification as Borrowed Speed
summary: Systems optimizing for demonstration accrue invisible verification debt (unchecked operating envelope) that surfaces only at a maturation event; the debt is invisible because a passed demo overwrites the question of full-envelope verification. Names a borrowed-vs-earned-speed discriminator gap as an open edge. Already promoted 2026-07-14.

title: The Direction-Cost Panel
summary: Combines the Governor (cost axis) and attractor currency (direction axis) into a four-quadrant reading, since cost-only monitoring cannot distinguish sustainable drift (low cost, wrong direction) from healthy depletion (high cost, right direction). Already promoted to canon 2026-06-28.

title: Ejection Immunity Through Personal Node Ownership
summary: When each participant instantiates their own copy of shared infrastructure rather than accessing one gatekept copy, removal becomes structurally impossible — retention becomes a property of topology, not policy. Names failure modes (partial instantiation, network-effect hollowing, fork divergence, onboarding asymmetry). Already promoted 2026-06-21.

title: Externalized Cost of an Unheld Boundary
summary: When someone declines to hold a boundary that is theirs, the cost transfers by default (no delegation event) to whoever stands nearest; a two-ledger asymmetry keeps material claims held privately while affective costs are pushed to the commons. Already Status: LIBRARY, crossed 2026-07-28.

title: Framework as Perceptual Instrument
summary: A framework transitions from analytic (checklist, applied after data-gathering) to perceptual (reads structural states directly off observable behavior) once internalization crosses a compression threshold. Names an articulability-plus-predictive-commitment falsifier and a blinding failure mode (named categories foreclose adjacent unnamed ones). Already Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-01.

title: Gap Invisible From Above
summary: A point-local structural defect registers only on the body that stands in that exact position; the aggregate self-report from every other position is genuinely, defensibly accurate, and reports from below re-type as complaints because the receiver above has no shared datum. Visibility is reachable only by descent, never by better reporting. Already Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-28.

title: Ground Then Record, Decoupled
summary: Admission to a floor is two separately-emitting acts — a cheap record (fires on speech/write) and a costly calibration (fires only on performed labor); under pressure to produce landings quickly, systems optimize toward the cheap half and publish records over unleveled ground. Already Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-28.

title: Extraction Legible Only as Lineage (instrument_as_self_portrait)
summary: A maker who cannot articulate what they need keeps rebuilding the instrument itself, and the rebuilding IS the extraction of unstated grammar — legible only in the version lineage, not any single artifact, and dying the moment a version is ratified. Notes the surface's own version history as v1 'tetra' → v2 'open grammar' → v3 'distributed verbs' — a naming for a rebuilt interface chassis, not a claim about NESI's own structure. Already Status: CANON (test protocol), promoted 2026-07-14.
tetra_relevance: Mentions a build lineage 'v1 tetra' as one named version of a rebuilt widget-week interface chassis — a label for that artifact, not a description of NESI as a tetrahedron or as having faces/facets.

title: Layout as State Encoding
summary: Interfaces should encode current process state in layout, labels, and button configuration so the user's first act is substantive rather than orientation work. Names five surfaces (material position, inline routing, urgency-as-weight, live-state labels, phase sequencing) that must all co-occur. Already Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-01.
tetra_relevance: Uses 'the tetra' as a name for a three-button phase-sequencing UI element ('Three buttons name three stages of one process... When all three buttons feel equally valid... the tetra has failed to encode phase'). This is an interface-design term for a three-button control, not a description of NESI as a tetrahedral or multi-face structure.

title: Silent Failure as False Positive (limits_as_information)
summary: A system that absorbs a limit without surfacing it sends the downstream a false positive ('completed normally') rather than silence; named limits do positive load-bearing work by locating a structure's floor. Distinguishes silent failure, performed disclosure, and structural incapacity to perceive one's own limit. Already Status: CANON, promoted 2026-07-28.

title: Mark It at the Body or It Does Not Cross

title: Metabolic Handoff
